summary: In a small computer model rather than human tests, Propranolol received low-risk scores for both liver and heart harm [M]. However, the medication carries an official boxed warning in the United States regarding heart harm [3]. Additionally, warnings note that stopping the drug abruptly can worsen chest pain known as angina pectoris and may even lead to a heart attack, also called a myocardial infarction [7]. Because of these risks, instructions recommend gradually lowering the dose over at least several weeks instead of quitting suddenly [7].
